# Tutor Companion 2.0.0 — Curriculum Engineering & Examination Engine

**Tutor Companion 2.0** brings institutional curriculum decomposition, contact-hour structured lecture notes, standard 3-tier exam generation with marking schemes, multi-year student biodata and gradebook ledger, and deep reference library integration alongside DeepTutor's agentic AI learning companion.

## Downloads & Installation

| Platform | Asset Name | Description & Installation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Windows PC** | **`Tutor-Companion-Setup-2.0.0.exe`** | Standalone installer with Start menu and Desktop shortcuts. Works 100% offline with local state storage and automatic background sync. |
| **Android** | **`Tutor-Companion-2.0.0.apk`** | Universal Android application (Android 9.0+) optimized for tablets and smartphones. Touch-optimized gradebook, document scanning, and offline notes. |
| **Web / PWA** | **`Tutor-Companion-Web-2.0.0.zip`** | Self-hosted package for intranet and institutional servers, installable as a Progressive Web App (PWA). |

---

## What's New in v2.0.0

### 1. Institutional Curriculum & Teacher's Guide Analysis
- **Universal Syllabus Ingestion**: Upload complete curriculum specifications (PDF, DOCX, TXT) or paste national course guidelines (e.g., *Diploma in Pharmacy*, *Certificate in Pharmacy*, nursing, computer science, or engineering).
- **Automated Decomposition**: Automatically identifies program duration, credit units, semesters, contact hours (lecture, tutorial, practical), and general course objectives.
- **Hierarchical Outlines**: Organizes modules into structured topics with specific allocated hours, learning outcomes, and suggested practical laboratory sessions.

### 2. Contact-Hour Structured Lecture Notes Engine
- **Contact Hours Alignment**: Lecture notes are systematically organized and sorted by syllabus contact hour blocks (e.g., *Hours 1–3*, *Hours 4–6*).
- **Pedagogical Structure**: Formulates clear learning outcomes, comprehensive theoretical foundations, worked clinical cases, and summary key takeaways.
- **Reference Grounding**: Directly cites uploaded reference textbooks, clinical guidelines, and pharmacopoeias.
- **Multi-Format Document Export**: One-click export to:
  - **Microsoft Word (`.doc`)**: Formatted document with headers, mathematical formulations, and clinical notes.
  - **Adobe PDF**: Printable, paginated institutional lecture guide.
  - **PowerPoint Slide Deck (`.ppt` / presentation outline)**: Slide-by-slide breakdowns with title slides, bulleted key concepts, and speaker notes.

### 3. 3-Tier Examinations, Coursework & Marking Schemes
- **Standard 3-Tier Exam Architecture**:
  - **Section A**: Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with comprehensive distractors and marked answers.
  - **Section B**: Short Structured Questions with targeted mark allocations.
  - **Section C**: Long Essay & Clinical Case Analysis with detailed diagnostic problem-solving.
- **Selective Topic Matrix**: Toggle specific topics to include or exclude from coursework or exams.
- **Past Paper & Blueprint Ingestion**: Upload custom institutional exam blueprints to match exact format conventions.
- **Complete Official Marking Schemes**: Step-by-step scoring keys, model answers, and rubric allocations.
- **Question Bank Integration**: Push generated questions directly to the interactive Question Bank.

### 4. Multi-Year Student Biodata & Gradebook Ledger
- **Cohort Organization**: Group and track students systematically by year of study (Year 1, Year 2, Year 3 cohorts).
- **Comprehensive Biodata**: Full profiles including Student ID, National Registration, DOB, Gender, Guardian Information, Emergency Phone, and Enrollment Status.
- **Interactive Gradebook**: Real-time inline editing for Continuous Assessments (CW1 & CW2), Mid-Term Tests, and Final Examination scores with instant automatic recalculation of Total Percentage, Grade Letter (A, B+, B, C, F), and Grade Point Average (GPA).
- **Import & Export**: Instant CSV roster and gradebook export.

### 5. Multi-Format Reference Document Library
- Secure storage for reference textbooks (e.g., *British Pharmacopoeia*, *Goodman & Gilman*), clinical treatment guidelines, pharmacopoeias, and anatomical/chemical diagrams.
- Real-time text extraction for grounding lecture notes and assessment formulations.

### 6. Deep Multi-Stage Problem Solver (`DeepSolve`)
- Multi-stage formal mathematical and clinical problem-solving.
- Multi-modal input support: typed text, uploaded calculation images, medical problem sheets, and voice notes.

## Offline Durability & Sync

All student data, curriculums, notes, and exam papers are stored securely on the local device via indexed offline storage. When connectivity is restored, cloud synchronization reconciles records seamlessly.
